items.label: ATM cash not dispensed (your bank's ATM)
items.source: CBN circular PSM/DIR/CON/CWO/07/127 dated 31 May 2020, effective 8 June 2020
items.note: Instant reversal is expected. If it fails, a manual reversal is expected within 24 hours. Newer CBN ATM operating guidelines may supersede this; check the latest circulars.

items.label: ATM cash not dispensed (another bank's ATM)
items.source: CBN circular PSM/DIR/CON/CWO/07/127 dated 31 May 2020, effective 8 June 2020
items.note: Refund within 48 hours. Newer CBN ATM operating guidelines may supersede this; check the latest circulars.

items.label: POS failure
items.source: CBN circular PSM/DIR/CON/CWO/07/127 dated 31 May 2020; CBN press release on payment channels (2020)
items.note: The circular says 48 hours and a CBN press release says 72 hours. We use 72 so a bank is never called late when it may not be.

items.label: Web checkout failure
items.source: CBN circular PSM/DIR/CON/CWO/07/127 dated 31 May 2020; CBN press release on payment channels (2020)
items.note: The circular says 48 hours and a CBN press release says 72 hours. We use 72 so a bank is never called late when it may not be.

items.label: Failed transfer (NIP)
items.note: Shown as an estimate. Check the latest CBN circulars.

items.label: Duplicate debit
items.source: Uses the window for the payment channel; no separate CBN source found
items.note: For a duplicate transfer there is no specific CBN source; shown as an estimate. For ATM, POS and web, the channel window applies.

items.label: Sent to the wrong account
items.note: There is no CBN deadline for a transfer sent to the wrong account. A recall request depends on the recipient and whether the money is still available.
